_comment: serverUrl empty = ads.js only ever shows the bundled house creatives below and never makes a network call. Point serverUrl at a deployed monetize/server to pull remote campaigns (see monetize/README.md). Ads never render at all unless (a) tier is free/not Pro and (b) the wizard's ads/telemetry consent step was accepted — see desktop/lib/entitlement.js and desktop/lib/ads.js.
